title: web UI: single markdown body field with derived title in the editor
description: The editor dialog (pkg/webui/assets/index.html + app.js) has separate Title and Description inputs. ../rais MeadsTaskDetail instead edits one markdown body and derives the title from its first line, matching md add rich parsing (title is the text before the first period-space or newline). Consider collapsing to a single body editor: less chrome, fewer fields, and consistent with the CLI. Keep an explicit fallback (Untitled) when the first line is empty.
